summary: Iteration 11 verified this session's changes end-to-end: browser-side tesseract.js OCR flow, Gemini (gemini-3.6-flash) provider on /api/scan, the post-login profile+history fetch bug fix, plus auth/profile/barcode/history regressions and Vercel deploy static config. Backend: new pytest file test_iter11_ocr_gemini.py -> 26/26 passed (AI scan calls limited to 2 to preserve Gemini quota). Frontend: 3 Playwright runs on the preview URL (mobile 390x844) covering login->immediate history/profile, paste-text AI scan, image-upload browser OCR -> AI scan, and profile save. All passed; no blocking issues found.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True (carried over from iteration 10, still open). Harmless today (Bearer tokens, no cookies) but invalid per spec.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on repeated failed logins (playbook item unmet; the auth here is custom token auth, not the Emergent auth playbook).
Signed base64 token has no expiry/revocation; 401 message 'session expired' is misleading.

issues: One Unsplash carousel image intermittently failed with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB in one of three runs (images.unsplash.com/photo-1615486364155-...). A later run showed 0 broken images. Consider an onError fallback/placeholder for remote article images.

action_items: Optional: add an onError placeholder for remote Unsplash news images (one ORB-blocked load observed).

Optional cleanup before deploy: delete dead SQLAlchemy-era modules (app/database.py, app/dependencies.py, app/models.py, app/analyzer.py, app/ai_explainer.py, app/routers/*, ingrelens.db, supabase_schema.sql, migrate_to_supabase.py, render.yaml). They import sqlalchemy which is NOT in the slim requirements.txt; safe today only because app/main.py never imports them.

Note: my seeded-account scan tests added 2 history rows named 'TEST Iter11 Granola' plus 'QA Paste Granola'/'QA OCR Granola' to ingretest@ingrelens.dev history (seeded history was NOT deleted, per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: Verified: /api/scan text-only path works (file param optional), Gemini selected when GEMINI_API_KEY is set (_call_gemini(prompt) if GEMINI_API_KEY else _call_claude(prompt)), and responses exclude Mongo _id.
Verified: onAuthed() now fetches /api/profile + /api/history after login; UI showed 17 history items and 'peanut' allergy tag immediately without refresh.
Dead sqlalchemy modules remain in /app/app — remove them so the Vercel function bundle cannot accidentally import missing deps.
src/lib/ocr.js swallows OCR errors (catch { return '' }) — a worker/CDN failure is indistinguishable from an unreadable photo; consider logging/distinct messaging.
